name: 年次有給休暇 (annual paid leave)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(1)–(2): 10 days after 6 months of continuous service with 80% attendance, then 11, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 days at 1½ to 6½ years and every year after; paid at the average wage, the ordinary wage or the standard daily remuneration as the work rules state (art.39(9)). art.39(7): where 10 or more days are granted the employer designates 5 days to be taken within the year; 労働基準法施行規則 art.24の7: the 年次有給休暇管理簿 is kept. art.115: untaken days lapse after 2 years. Buying back leave is not permitted (昭和30年11月30日 基収4718号), so the class is not encashable and is not settled on exit. art.39(3) with 施行規則 art.24の3: a worker of 4 or fewer scheduled days and under 30 hours a week (terms.facts weekly_scheduled_days, weekly_scheduled_hours) is granted 7–15, 5–11, 3–7 or 1–3 days for 4, 3, 2 or 1 days a week. The balance meters each service year (window SERVICE_YEAR) and the unused days carry into the next year once (art.115: 2 years). Each grant year runs from the 六箇月経過日 (entitlement.service_year_offset_months 6). art.39(1)–(2) 80% condition: the grant needs attendance on 80% of the 全労働日 of the window before it (attendance.previous: the six months to the 六箇月経過日, then each grant year). 全労働日 = scheduled WORK days less published holidays and days of 代替休暇 (SUBSTITUTE_LEAVE_FOR_OVERTIME; 平成21年5月29日 基発0529001号); attended = days worked plus days of annual leave, 産前産後休業, 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 and 業務上の傷病による休業 (art.39(10); 昭和22年9月13日 発基17号), capped at the 全労働日. The months before the first one with attendance or leave recorded (before the roster was kept here) are left out of both sides, and a window with no 全労働日 recorded grants. Days of a work_suspension leave the 全労働日 as their suspension_kind says (EMPLOYER_CAUSED, FORCE_MAJEURE, STRIKE, LOCKOUT, GOVERNMENT_ORDER: not scheduled, 平成25年7月10日 基発0710第3号).

pay.name: 年次有給休暇の賃金 (annual leave pay, hourly and daily paid)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(9): paid annual leave is paid the ordinary wage for the scheduled hours (an hourly rate times the scheduled daily hours, terms.facts.scheduled_daily_hours; a daily rate), or the average wage where the work rules say so (company.facts.annual_leave_pay_basis AVERAGE; art.12). A monthly wage is not reduced for leave days. The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (earned.months leave_days, suspended_days_by_kind) and the probation period (terms.facts.probation_until, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); worked_days).
